policy.roster: Exact operational 2024–25 CCD LEA 0622710 attachments only.
policy.school_types: Retain locally funded charters, alternatives and other exact roster types; no fit-driven exclusions.
policy.populations: Pure grade schools and pure high schools separately; mixed schools excluded.
policy.models: Separate 2024–25 Smarter Balanced district Math, ELA and Combined OLS models by pure level.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals with the deleted-school residual scale.
policy.intervals: Conditional sampling intervals propagate every member through I−H with the regression scale held fixed; any missing member count omits modelwide intervals.
policy.combined: Equal mean of Math and ELA; variance is (sqrt(v_math)+sqrt(v_ELA))²/4. Minimum subject count is display-only.
policy.release: Independent numerical audit only; canonical import, browser integration and release review remain outstanding.

replay_tolerance.scope: Computed numerical metrics only. Source evidence, identity, configuration, membership and counts compare exactly.
